ui_87bfadafaea3b248: Imiterere yubushakashatsi yo ku ya 8 Ukwakira 2026.Ibisobanuro byerekana amashusho hejuru bigarura ukundi.
ui_d41d826aa43ae0f5: Ibicuruzwa bikomoka kuri CME bisobanura ibiciro byigihe kizaza, ntabwo amasezerano ya Federasiyo. Gufata / kuzamura / gukata ibirango ukoreshe urutonde rwanyuma rushoboka. Gereranya inama imwe hamwe nintego-igipimo cyigihe kimwe. Ibishyimbo hamwe nishoramari birashobora kugabana ibyinjira byimbere, ntabwo rero ari amajwi yigenga. Impinduka mugusaranganya irashobora kwerekana amakuru mashya, ibiciro byamasezerano cyangwa ibitekerezo; impuzandengo idahuye yongeweho ibinyoma.
ui_4261cc1e72bdcb33: Ibiciro bizamura ibiciro bitumizwa mu mahanga, ariko ibiciro byabaguzi biterwa n’imipaka, ibarura, gusimbuza ibicuruzwa n’ibisabwa. Ubushakashatsi bwa New York Fed yo ku ya 6 Ukwakira busobanura buhoro buhoro. Urwego rwo hejuru rwibiciro ntirukeneye gusobanura ifaranga rihoraho burundu: ifaranga ryumwaka rishobora koroshya igihe ubwiyongere bwambere bwagabanutse kubigereranya. Guhindura ibiciro inshuro nyinshi cyangwa umushahara uhoraho hamwe ningaruka ziteganijwe birashobora kongera igitutu.
ui_825a86cc728d9569: Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe na New York Fed muri Nyakanga bwerekanye ko ibigo bimwe byo mu karere bikomeje gutegura izamuka ry’ibiciro nyuma yo kwishyura imisoro. Ibyo ni ibimenyetso byerekana umuyoboro ushobora kuba, ntabwo iteganyagihe ry’ifaranga ry’igihugu cyangwa ubushakashatsi bushya bwo mu Kwakira. Ikigereranyo cy'Imisoro gisobanura ingaruka za politiki ntangarugero, ntabwo byatangajwe CPI. Suzuma ibiciro byagaragaye, ifaranga rya serivisi hamwe n'ibiteganijwe guta agaciro mbere yo gufata umutwe wibiciro nkibimenyetso byicyemezo runaka.
ui_422afc9773ac3b29: Intangiriro PCE, ibiciro byagutse byiyongera nibiteganijwe kuzamuka byashimangira urubanza rwo kwifata. Guha akazi byoroshye, ubushomeri bukabije hamwe n’ubushake buke byongera ikiguzi cyo gukaza umurego. Gufata birashobora kwemerera ibimenyetso byinshi gushika utabujije kwimuka nyuma. Soma ibisobanuro, gutora, ibiteganijwe mugihe byateganijwe, hamwe nabanyamakuru hamwe. CNBC hamwe nindi mitwe ya Federasiyo iri munsi wongereho raporo; ibisobanuro ntabwo arikindi cyitegererezo gishoboka.
